news.title: CCE alum to achieve lifelong space dream aboard Purdue 1
news.summary_en: Jason Williamson will become the first Purdue civil engineer to travel to space during the Purdue 1 suborbital flight in 2027.

news.title: ME's Malshe testifies to US Senate today about innovation in small businesses
news.summary_en: During a Senate Small Business Committee hearing before the Congressional recess, Sen. Todd Young (R-IN) asked CEO of Arkwright Space Dr. Ajay P. Malshe about the benefits of small businesses over larger companies.

news.title: Purdue researcher Jay Gore awarded prestigious ASME Holley Medal for 'brilliance of the art'
news.summary_en: Purdue Engineering is pleased to announce that Jay Gore, Reilly University Chair Professor in the School of Mechanical Engineering, has been awarded the highly prestigious 2026 Holley Medal by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME).
